_comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/check-supply-chain.mjs. Every entry carries a reason and the checker fails on an entry with none, and on an entry nothing references any more — an allow-list without reasons is a mute suppression list, and one that outlives its risk is worse.

domains.github.com: prose citations only — upstream projects credited in SKILL.md bodies (plannotator, agent-toolkit) and this repo's own URL. No script fetches from it.
domains.api.github.com: cited in the awesome-copilot survey as a re-verification command for the reader to run, not executed by anything we ship.
domains.developers.openai.com: documentation URL in a source comment in install-codex-agents.mjs recording where the Codex subagent schema was verified. Not fetched.
domains.raw.githubusercontent.com: session-report's analyzers fetch litellm's public pricing table at runtime — see remoteFetches for the specific URL and its risk.
domains.www.npmjs.com: prose citation in plugins/condux/README.md — the package page for @jabworks/condux, the OpenCode install channel this repo publishes. Nothing fetches it.
domains.agent-plugins.org: the $schema identifier in Agent Plugins manifests (plugins/docket/mcp.json, generated root plugin.json) — a spec version selector clients match as a constant string. Nothing fetches it.

remoteFetches.https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriA: session-report reads live model pricing to cost a session. Pinned to BerriAI/litellm's main branch, so the content can change with no diff here and no review — accepted because the analyzers degrade to cached/absent pricing rather than failing, and the data never reaches an eval or a shipped artifact. Revisit if either stops being true: pin a commit sha, or vendor a snapshot.

scripts.plugins/condux/install.mjs: condux's plugin-level install front door — the one executable this repo ships outside skills/. Wraps the three installers scattered inside skills (Codex agents, the plan-review Stop hook, the OpenCode plugin key) and is what INSTALL.md tells an agent to run; behaviour covered by tests/script-safety.test.mjs. Declaring it also clears the INVOKES-SCRIPT findings on every `node … install.mjs` line in INSTALL.md and README.md, since invocations are matched by basename.
scripts.skills/concord-doctor/doctor.mjs: concord's doctor — probes and repairs the plugin's own registration.
scripts.skills/condux-doctor/conflicts.mjs: reads the known-conflicts registry for the doctor and condux's installer. Reads other people's config and skill directories, so it is deliberately the narrowest thing that can: filesystem reads and name matching only, no network and no child processes, asserted by tests/condux-conflicts.test.mjs.
scripts.skills/discovery/references/choice-serve: local decision server for discovery's picker; binds loopback only.
scripts.skills/plan-review/references/annotate-s: local annotation server behind plan-review's browser UI; binds loopback only, and its HTML template is the original no-egress guarantee this checker generalizes.
scripts.skills/plan-review/references/install-co: registers plan-review's Codex Stop hook; behaviour covered by tests/script-safety.test.mjs.
scripts.skills/spec-browser/references/build-ind: builds the static spec index; no network.
scripts.skills/record/server/docket.mjs: docket's dependency-free CLI — rung 2 of the degrade-gracefully ladder, and the file the ladder names as its rung-2 example.
scripts.skills/record/server/docket-core.mjs: docket's parser and id allocator, shared by the CLI and the MCP server.
scripts.skills/record/server/docket-render.mjs: renders the docket board to self-contained HTML.
scripts.skills/record/server/mcp-server.mjs: docket's MCP server — rung 3 of the ladder, registered via .mcp.json.
scripts.skills/record/server/install.sh: docket's installer; verifies what it registers.
scripts.skills/remember/bin/capture.mjs: concord's capture entry point, invoked by the Codex rollout hook.
scripts.skills/remember/lib/budget.mjs: concord internals — token budget for injected memory.
scripts.skills/remember/lib/store.mjs: concord internals — the memory store itself.
scripts.skills/remember/references/install-codex: registers concord's Codex hooks; idempotency covered by tests/script-safety.test.mjs.
scripts.skills/session-report/analyze-claude.mjs: parses Claude Code transcripts into the usage report. Fetches litellm pricing — see remoteFetches.
scripts.skills/session-report/analyze-codex.mjs: parses Codex transcripts into the usage report. Fetches litellm pricing — see remoteFetches.
scripts.skills/subagent-execution/references/ins: installs the four condux specialist agents for Codex; dry-run behaviour covered by tests/script-safety.test.mjs.
scripts.skills/subagent-execution/references/rev: assembles a review package for the code-review flow; local only.
scripts.skills/subagent-execution/references/tas: renders a task brief for a spawned agent; local only.
scripts.skills/technical-spec/references/scaffol: scaffolds a specs/ tree; path-escape refusal covered by tests/script-safety.test.mjs.
scripts.skills/session-handoff/hooks/session-sta: session-handoff's SessionStart nudge — conditional routing directive when handoffs exist, both hosts, fails open; behavior gated by tests/session-handoff-hooks.test.mjs.
scripts.skills/workflow/hooks/session-start.mjs: condux's SessionStart hook — injects the routing payload on both hosts, fails open.
